title: About Dr. Praveen Gupta
hero_desc: Gold Medalist from AIIMS New Delhi with over 20 years of transformative leadership in Indian and global neurology.
section1_title: A Legacy of Innovation in Neurology
section1_text: Dr. Praveen Gupta has pioneered numerous landmark interventions in India, including the first Brain Pacemaker for Epilepsy in Asia, Deep Brain Stimulation for Parkinson's, and mechanical thrombectomy for acute stroke.
